deployments_detail.use: AI assistant for suppliers analyzing retail-network performance data
AI solutions in own production complex to boost manufacturing efficiency

Computer vision system in 430 large-format stores (Magnit Semeyny supermarkets, Magnit Extra superstores) that uses neural networks on existing CCTV feeds to monitor shelf display quality, product availability, staff presence in service zones, shopping-cart availability, and checkout queue formation, sending alerts to store managers. Built in-house by Magnit Tech; scaled network-wide over six months. [Magnit Tech (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 430 stores; measurable sales increase and loss reduction (no figure disclosed)

deployments_detail.use: Shelf product-recognition ('Image Recognition') technology: a neural network recognizes product images on shelves from photos and checks whether the actual planogram/layout matches the required one, acting as a digital assistant for in-store merchandising staff. Scaled across stores. [Magnit (in-house / Magnit Tech)]

Platform of 17 corporate chatbots built on Russian AI vendor CraftTalk, operating as text contact centers over Telegram/Viber. Bots cover HR (salary, vacations, document filing), document-management help, loyalty-program/card consultations, new-store-opening coordination, and IT support (account status, password reset), connected to HelpDesk and Active Directory. [CraftTalk]

Demand forecasting and replenishment using big data and neural networks / machine learning. Magnit reported that after introducing AI elements, forecasting accuracy rose by 2.4%, above the industry average. Builds on the unified Forecasting & Replenishment (F&R) system originally deployed on Relex Solutions' cloud platform. [Relex Solutions; Magnit in-house ML]

AI in Magnit's own production and agricultural complex (20 industrial/agro facilities): four AI solutions being deployed/piloted - computer-vision greenhouse video analytics assessing plant health, detecting disease and forecasting yield; a voice-recognition system 'Голос' letting equipment operators report malfunctions by speech; AI analysis of tender/supplier commercial proposals; and smart watches that analyze production-staff activity to identify best practices. [Magnit (in-house)]

BeautyScan: AI service for personalized cosmetics/perfume selection in Magnit Cosmetic stores. Customer scans an in-store QR code, uploads a face photo and answers questions; neural networks and computer vision perform skin diagnostics and recommend products. Scaled to ~2,500 Magnit Cosmetic stores. [Magnit (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: ~2,500 stores; +5% sales reported in earlier pilot

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven personalization of promotional offers and loyalty program: Magnit uses AI algorithms and big data from ~55 million customer loyalty cards to manage thousands of customer microsegments and deliver individualized promos, discounts and mass-promo personalization (developed with Sber ecosystem/GK Innoretail). [Magnit with Sber]
deployments_detail.value: ~55 million loyalty cards used for segmentation

deployments_detail.use: 'Mэджик' (Magic) generative-AI shopper assistant launched in the Magnit mobile app. Helps customers pick products (meal ideas for breakfast/lunch/dinner), find the biggest discounts, navigate stores and self-checkout, select cosmetics, check order status and resolve issues without contacting support. Developed by the internal IT team. [Magnit (in-house IT team)]

AI-based analysis of customer feedback (voice-of-customer / NPS): a system that 'listens' to customers and helps convert detractors into promoters, tied to revenue growth. Documented as a vendor case study for Magnit. [Generation AI]
